p.t: Why The Heck Did I Buy This House
p.d: San Antonio-based designer and renovator Kim Wolfe comes to the rescue of homeowners who have major buyer's remorse; Kim uses her expert skills to reinvent their lifeless spaces and make homeowners finally fall in love with their house.

Kortney and Dave flip a run-down craftsman home in a hip and trendy neighbourhood. A modern design plan with a hefty budget is used entice the right buyer because the challenging location threatens to derail their profit projections.
A New York City couple takes advantage of a job opportunity and relocates to London; she wants a place in a lively location while he prefers something tranquil in a quiet neighbourhood.

Find out what's going on in the world with a news bulletin designed for children, featuring stories that are relevant and easy to understand.

The semifinals kick off inside the legendary Gringotts Wizarding Bank, where hosts James and Oliver Phelps ask the remaining four baking teams to create showpieces that magically bring an iconic Harry Potter creature to life.

The Bears book a night at a hotel for dogs.

Homer the turtle is going on holidays while his owner is overseas. What can go wrong? Well try finding the little fellow in the fangs of the resident pooch. Babysitter Jody is guilt ridden and the traumatised Homer is the victim of a big bacteria bite. Can Chris save the day for everyone?

Chris heads to the Victorian high country to help out a mate and to realise a boyhood dream of becoming a vet in the bush. It’s a challenging week as he treats everything from horses to wombats and monkeys and helps save a mother in trouble. Monkeys carry some nasty diseases and watch for Chris’ concerns about what he might leave Mansfield with. Talk about a dangerous job.

Observe as Chris treats Pearl, a poodle that began bleeding internally at the groomer, while surgeons try to save Zoe, a cat that dove off a second-floor balcony. Meanwhile, the clinic gets a special gift from a grateful patient.

Join the team’s 24-hour vigil for Lucu, a pup that’s been bitten by a tick. Then check out Jonti, a cat with a gaping hole in his neck that’s scarily close to his jugular vein—all while Chris tangles with an evasive lame emu.
A bizarre looking baby cockatoo has fallen twenty metres out of her nest and wants to alert the whole world to her plight. Can Chris help the little screamer? And will she ever be able to fly?

Chris fights to save one of the clinic’s favorite patients. Beautiful Bluebell was dumped on the doorstep of the clinic as a kitten and adopted out to a loving family. Now he is the victim of a hit run accident.

The Australian Reptile Park operations manager, Tim Faulkner ropes Chris into a frightening mission in far north Queensland. A monster seven metre python called Big Mamma is living in the roof of a local boating club and the female paddlers are terrified. It's all up to the intrepid duo as they head to Cairns to try to capture the scary reptile.

A quick thinking police officer in Sydney’s infamous King Cross has rescued a twelve-week old puppy and rushed her into the Bondi clinic. The puppy was found sweltering in forty degree heat in a plastic handbag and the culprit has been arrested. Little Tilly soon finds a place in Chris’ heart and home where she has a confrontation with the resident cat, George. Without a microchip, the search is on for her owner.

A morning walk has gone tragically wrong for Tigger and his distressed owner Bernadette. A street cleaner spooked it and sent him charging into a car. Chris is trying to calm them both down to find out the extent of his injuries.

Ziggy is a dog with an embarrassing problem. A huge mass is hanging off his back leg. Bemused vet nurse Neil tells us it's like a third testicle swinging in the wind. But when it comes to surgery it's no laughing matter for Chris.

Boris the Staffy was born with a cleft palate and seven operations have failed. Jess won't give up, so Chris attempts Australia's first surgery of its kind—raising eight grand to give Boris one last chance.

West Highland terrier, Chester lives in Bondi but has a fanatical hatred of skateboarders. It’s a dangerous combination and one that is making life hell for his owners Mark and Jess. They’re worried Chester could bite someone.
Chris is spending 2 weeks volunteering at the busy Esther Honey vet clinic in the Cook Islands. This week his first patient is a much-loved cat called Small One, which has part of its nose missing.

Chris makes a special trip to Karara to see Stubby, a tiny 3-week-old piglet, born with only one trotter. Stubby is struggling to get around. If the brave little battler is to survive, Chris needs to work out a way for her to walk normally.

Chris travels to Edgars Mission, where he is faced with Ben Hall, a sheep that was rescued after 5 years on the run, and Chris is shocked at the condition of his heavy coat. The thick wool could be hiding all sorts of health problems.

Ice is the deadliest enemy. Former soldier and archaeologist Ben Timberlake is on a mission to reveal the ice's role in wars past, present, and future. From hunting lost WW1 bunkers in Italy, to secret Cold War nuclear bases in Greenland's ice, to modern-day Arctic espionage on Russia's border.

Nearly six years of our lives are spent dreaming. Yet there is so much untapped creative potential in our dreams. What if we could take the brilliant ideas from our dreams and turn them into reality? How can we make our dreams more meaningful?

No one lives forever, but scientists will never stop trying to combat aging. Now, laboratories around the world have been successful with rejuvenation in animals such as mice and fruit flies. If animals are living longer and healthier lives, can this research benefit humans?

Air travel is a climate killer. But if we stop flying we'll have a global logistics problem, with numerous supply chains interrupted. If we want to keep flying, it's time for a revolutionary energy transformation. Luckily, the necessary technologies already exist.

Thanks to Artificial Intelligence, robots can recognize us, drive cars, perform surgeries with precision, create art and play a perfect game of chess. But can robots also have feelings? Will we ever consider robots our friends, or love them like real humans? And above all, can they love us back?

Our ice hides a menagerie of life. Microbial ecologist Dr. Allison Fong goes on a journey to uncover the mighty power of these tiny creatures. From life-saving cures hidden in volcanic ice caves, to alien-like worms with bizarre adaptations, to blood-red algae that could transform distant glaciers.

While the graphic art of Ancient Egypt is very familiar, little is known about the artists and scribes. Who were they? How important were they to the Pharaohs? From Saqqara to the Valley of Kings, explore the lives of our first historians on record.
While a prisoner in North Korea, George Blake was recruited by the Soviets to spy on the British. He was caught and sentenced to prison but escaped to the Soviet Union.

Gabrielle Kleim was one of many women working in West Germany targeted by Romeo Spies. Duped into sharing intelligence for love at the behest of the Man Without a Face, East German HVA Intel Chief Marcus Wolf.

The battle between the French and English for the French territory of New France hinges on the presence of the British navy. And the Battle on the Plains of Abraham is tipped to Great Britain by the solidly trained soldiers of the British army. This changed the landscape of North America.
Timing is everything, just look at what happened in 1848. How did the finding of gold in Sutter's Mill make an impact on the development of California and the history of the United States?

A Navy pilot is forced to grow up during the course of a specialised training program in California. Hotshot pilot Maverick has to contend with his attraction to his beautiful flight instructor, a rival pilot, Iceman, and the ghosts of his past.

Undercover policeman Carter befriends petty criminal Moses, so that he can acquire evidence against drug lord Frank Colton. The truth is revealed when Moses is arrested and Carter is ordered to transfer him to the court, as Colton waits to strike.

p.t: The Naked Gun 2 1/2: The Smell of Fear
p.d: Lt Frank Debrin uncovers a plot by the polluting energy giants to derail ecological plans that could render their products redundant. They're led by the evil Quentin Hapsburg who, to make matters worse, is romancing Frank's ex, Jane Spencer.
An arrogant TV weatherman finds himself repeating the same day over and over again when he goes on location to the small town of Punxsutawney to film a report about their annual Groundhog Day.
The crew face an unexpected challenge when a mysterious woman forces Dom to betray them. They must unite to bring home the man who made them a family and stop a villain from unleashing chaos.
In 1990s Miami, a gym manager and his muscular accomplices kidnap a wealthy businessman and force him to sign over all his assets, including cars and a luxurious mansion, to them.
Former FBI agent Will Sawyer is framed for the burning of a building in China. When his family become trapped in the building, he must save them while also trying to clear his name.
Rick O'Connell returns to Egypt for a second crack at the evil Imhotep, who has enlisted the dark services of the Scorpion King and his army of jackal warriors.
When a criminal plot endangers the beach, Mitch Buchannon leads his elite squad of lifeguards on a mission to prove that one doesn't need to wear a badge to save the bay.

After defeating Owen Shaw and his crew, Dominic, Brian and the rest of the crew return to the US and live the normal life again, but Owen's older brother, Deckard Shaw, is after Dominic, seeking revenge for the death of his brother.
The crew face an unexpected challenge when a mysterious woman forces Dom to betray them. They must unite to bring home the man who made them a family and stop a villain from unleashing chaos.
Two mismatched NYC detectives seize an opportunity to step up like the city's top cops, whom they idolise.
The GI Joe team are not only fighting their enemy Cobra, they also have to face threats from within the government that jeopardise their very existence.
Four teens embark on the adventure of a lifetime when an old video game magically transports them to the jungle world of Jumanji and transforms them into their adult avatars.
Spencer returns to the fantastical world of Jumanji. His friends Martha, Fridge, and Bethany follow his footsteps in an effort to try and bring him home.

During an expedition Dr Rick Marshall, his research assistant, and a redneck survivalist are sucked into a space-time vortex. They find themselves in an alternate universe and become friends with a primate named Chaka.

On the isle of Berk, a Viking boy named Hiccup defies tradition by befriending a dragon named Toothless. However, when an ancient threat emerges that endangers both species, Hiccup's friendship with Toothless becomes the key to forging a new future.

When the Primm family move to New York City, their young son, Josh, struggles to adapt to his new school and new friends. All of that changes when he meets Lyle, a singing crocodile who loves baths, caviar, and great music.
A king, a mighty warrior and a powerful wizard unite to defend the human realm of Azeroth from a tyrannical shaman and his invading army of orcs.

S11 E2 — Episode 2Ninety-three thousand cars were stolen last year - one every six minutes, and with 1800 thefts occurring across the East Midlands every week alone, Derbyshire's Traffic Cops are always on the hunt for car thieves.
S3 E3 — Episode 3With three million dashcams now in vehicles, a look at some of Britain's worst driving offenders.
S12 E1 — Episode 1Tom chases a fleeing petrol thief, Mike corners a criminal in a text-book manoeuvre, and Jim deals with a suspect who can't control his tongue or bladder.
S15 E7 — Episode 7Shocking reports of a missing group of monks on the iconic shores has the lifeguard team on high alert.
S16 E99 — Episode 99Judge Judy Sheindlin tackles real-life small claims cases with her no nonsense attitude.
S16 E100 — Episode 100Judge Judy Sheindlin tackles real-life small claims cases with her no nonsense attitude.
S18 E106 — Episode 106A woman claims her mother owes for a title loan she took out on her car, to help her through some difficult times.
S18 E107 — Episode 107A car collision between a teenager and an adult with three children in his vehicle leads to a boxing match between two angry fathers.
S2 E23 — Episode 23A traveller swallows an unknown substance. A Thai vacation guide offers more than holiday advice. Photo gear might spoil a snowboarder's birthday.
S15 E19 — Episode 19A passenger returning from China has 2 extra passports in his bag and officers are keen to know why. A forensic check of them reveals something very interesting.

S13 E18 — Episode 18In New Zealand, the term 'Police Ten 7' means 'Police have arrived on the scene'. This unique fly-on-the-wall reality series brims with action as it follows urban cops on the beat.
S3 E1 — Episode 1A silly decision by a truck driver to attempt a U-turn across a median strip causes chaos. A passenger who demands a ticket from a police officer gets more than she bargained for.
S6 E7 — Episode 7The Special Operations Response Team is called to a fall on Arthur’s Seat. Meanwhile, in Aberdeen, a student paramedic faces some difficult patients on her final training shift.
S12 E2 — Episode 2Gordo and Dan unleash their tasers to arrest a knife-wielding teen, while Jim leads five police units to box in a suspected drug vehicle.

S30 E9 — Wrong Way HomeA parolee manages to outrun officers, but his luck runs out. A quarrelling couple attract their neighbours' attention, and police are called to intervene. A driver blames his freak accident on bad weather.
A standoff between a small-town sheriff and mayor sparks a powder keg as neighbour is pitted against neighbour in May 2020 in Eddington, N.M.
In the summer of 1930, the Crawleys grapple with the threat of social disgrace when Mary finds herself at the centre of a public scandal and the family faces financial trouble.
Famed opera singer Maria Callas retreats to Paris in the 1970s after a glamorous yet tumultuous life in the public eye.

Hannah and her non-binary teenager Frances visit her gay grandfather Jimpa in Amsterdam. Frances expresses a desire to stay with their grandfather for a year, challenging Hannah's parenting beliefs and forcing her to confront past issues.
Spider-Man's identity is revealed to everyone, and he can no longer separate his normal life from his superhero life. When he asks Doctor Strange for help, the stakes become even more dangerous.
Explores 20 years of Spider-Man history across three live-action Peters, tracing suit and stunt evolutions up through Tom Holland's next chapter with director Destin Daniel Cretton.
When the girl of his dreams gets kidnapped, a man turns his inability to feel pain into an unexpected advantage as he fights a bunch of thugs to get her back.

When Mike's 11-year-old sister sneaks out to reconnect with Freddy, Bonnie, Chica and Foxy, she sets into motion a terrifying series of events that reveal dark secrets about the true origin of Freddy's.

A masked maniac with glowing, red eyes returns every Valentine's Day to slaughter unsuspecting couples. When a cynical ad executive and her hopelessly romantic colleague become the next target, they decide to fight back and end the reign of terror.

On the eve of the 2002 FIFA World Cup, the Irish captain Roy Keane forfeits his place in the squad at the team's preparation base in Saipan, following a heated disagreement with the Irish manager Mick McCarthy.
A socially awkward tween endures the ruthless hierarchy at a water polo camp, his anxiety spiralling into psychological turmoil over the summer.

After learning that their victim, Maya, is still alive, three masked maniacs return to finish the job. With nowhere to run and no one to trust, Maya finds herself in a fight for survival against psychopaths who'll kill anyone who stands in their way.
Maya squares off against the masked killers one last time in a brutal, full-circle reckoning of survival and revenge.
A border town sheriff faces the wrath of a brutal cartel when a mysterious prisoner lands in his jail.

Quarterback Cameron Cade trains at an isolated compound with his hero, Isaiah White. As training progresses, Isaiah's charisma turns into something darker, sending Cam down a disorienting rabbit hole that may cost him more than he ever bargained for.

After finding out about her fiancé's cheating ways, a pop superstar impulsively marries a total stranger. As forces conspire to separate the unlikely newlyweds, they must decide if two people from such different worlds can find true love.
A teen suffers the pain of adolescence as she longs for Mr Right while fending off the advances of the class clown.
While attending their son's college graduation, a divorced couple reignite the spark in their relationship.
The parents of a young man who still lives at home hire a beautiful woman to entice him to finally leave the nest.
An ousted sports agent attempts to rebuild his career with the help of a loyal accountant and an egotistical athlete.
While pursuing the most popular girl in school, an artsy outcast gets some help from his tomboy best friend, who has a crush of her own.

When Eddie Brock acquires the powers of a symbiote, he will have to release his alter-ego \"Venom\" to save his life.
Four high-school kids discover an old video game console and are immediately drawn into the game's jungle setting, learning you don't just play Jumanji, you must survive it.
As they return to Jumanji to rescue one of their own, nothing is as they expect. They will have to brave parts unknown and unexplored to escape the world's most dangerous game.
A heartbroken pop star spontaneously weds a stranger from the audience while live on stage, but their sham marriage turns into a real romance.
In ancient China, a group of European mercenaries encounters a secret army that maintains and defends the Great Wall of China against a horde of monstrous creatures.

p.t: Once Upon A Time... In Hollywood

p.d: Legendary monster hunter Van Helsing must rely on the help of the beautiful and mysterious Anna Valeris as he engages in an epic battle with the ultimate forces of darkness.

A dark but feel-good comedy starring Tom Hanks as a grumpy loner who goes around telling people to follow the rules. Underneath his cranky nature is something deeper-whats made him turn out like this?
The wealthy live in luxury on a space station while the rest fight for scraps on a ruined Earth. Then one man is given an opportunity to even the score.
A pilot is selected to attend the Top Gun Naval Flying School while also pursuing a relationship with an instructor.
A young woman tries to ease the pain of her fiance's death by sending texts to his old cell phone number, and forms a connection with the man the number has been reassigned to.

Olympic bronze medalist and ten-time X Games medalist Mark McMorris wants the world to know there's more to snowboarding than tricks and trophies. Traveling the world and riding with the sport's best, he explores snowboard culture.

Skimboard odysseys include South Africa, Hawaii, Brazil, Mexico, Laguna Beach, Newport Beach, and LA County. If you haven't seen this video, then you haven't seen the longest, most epic waves ever skimmed. Directed by Bill and George Bryan. Starring Bill Bryan, George Bryan, Morgan Just, Erick Rosenberry, Jackson Tenney, Chris da Canha.

Jack Coleman's Nameless Direction Underground premieres his fourth fully independent feature length surf film. Groove Move celebrates the pure heart and soul of surfing, with the world's top experimental board riders. Directed by Jack Coleman. Derek Hynd, Dave Rastovich, Alex Knost, Joel Tudor, Ozzie Wright, Rob Machado, Ford Archbold and more.

p.t: Just Getting Started - The Life We Chose
p.d: S1 E1The first glimpse behind the scenes of the Norco Race Division on the opening weekend of the UCI Downhill World Cup in Fort William, Scotland. An unfiltered view into the life chosen by the team riders, led by the legendary Greg Minnaar, with access to the emotions, tribulations, and passion for the sport.

Before fatherhood, Australian surfer/filmmaker/musician Nick Colbey takes one last must-do trip. The Buckety is self-shot, self-narrated and self-scored as he chases dream waves from Hawaii to South Africa, then the UK and Ireland-through missed flights, wipeouts and kind strangers. Less performance, more presence.

S1 E1The Onboard crew spent some time with pro surfer Wade Goodall learning about what Channel Islands surfboards he's on the most, getting some insights into his new film with Vans "Pentacoastal," and sharing some fun waves they caught in between.

S1 E2In a show that stuns the eye with the finest contemporary high-performance surfing out there, Luca Elder, from the Onboard Store digital shop, gets together with Australia's Soli Bailey, to break down his quiver and talk about his favorite surfboards and the different wave conditions under which he uses them.

S1 E1Join João as he explores new terrains, showcases thrilling action sports, and immerses himself in Portugal's stunning landscapes. Expect more adrenaline, epic rides, and unforgettable experiences in this exciting new season!

Simon Hetrick is not your typical free surfer. His job is not just to perform in front of the camera. He also edits, produces, and record some of the music of his videos. Glitch showcases the last trips he did, abroad and at home, with sessions in Portugal, Mexico, Outer Banks, and at the Waco Wave Pool, among others.

S1 E8Shannon and Shayne explore the island of Taiwan and surf epic, typhoon-powered waves, check out the tallest building in the world, dance with native aborigines, and discover a hip and thriving surf culture.

p.d: S1 E1Miles arrives for his first visit to Camp Woodward, while Tony and Tyler return for another session. The three campers deal with lost luggage, orientation, and testing.

The Stanley Hotel, inspiration for Stephen King’s “The Shining”, is the setting for this TAPS investigation.

Donna suggests that the TAPS team travel to Tombstone, Arizona, in order to investigate the possibility of paranormal activity at the Birdcage Theater, a former drinking and burlesque hall that is the only remaining original building in the town.
TAPS continue their investigation into the paranormal history of the old west by heading to Bisbee, Arizona to uncover the secrets at The Copper Queen Hotel.
The team travels to a Vermont home and investigates the closed West Virginia State Penitentiary in Moundsville, West Virginia to investigate phenomena attributed to shadow people.
In Massachusetts, TAPSexplores a Victorian mansion with a bizarre history of unexplained activity.

The legendary hotel that served as inspiration for Stephen King's horror novel The Shining has an extensive history of mysterious and unexplainable phenomena, such as reports of the sounds of children playing in the halls on the fourth floor.

Jason and Grant head to Ireland to investigate Leap Castle, considered by many to be one of the most haunted places in the world. One of the spirits in the castle is an elemental that was supposedly summoned by dark arts, and is reported to be hostile and perhaps even deadly.
Continuing their investigation in Europe, TAPS explores the mysterious Lisheen Ruinsin Ireland.

Still on their European tour, TAPS heads to the Hellfire Caves in West Wycombe to investigate the paranormal activity. Then, on their day off, Jason and Grant take a tour of Jack the Ripper's haunts were they learn more about the gruesome murders.

When a mother comes to them for help, TAPS takes on a local case at the Tedeschi's House where strange voices are heard and toys come on by themselves. Then it's on to the MacLean's House to investigate strange noises and shaking that are coming from under the house. Jason and Grant head up to the attic where a whole new investigation begins.

TAPS travels to Chesapeake, Virginia to investigate the Keffer's House which suffers from apparitions, voices, and possibly a possessed doll. Then Steve is put in charge of his own investigation when he and TAPS head to Charlestown (Rhode Island) to investigate The General Stanton Inn where apparitions and voices have been seen and heard.

TAPS heads down to Corpus Christi, Texas to investigate the U.S.S. Lexington, an aircraft carrier where over 400 officers died on board during it's 21 out of 24 battles in WW2. Then it's on to a local case in Warwick at City Hall, where the sound of a woman crying has been heard and ghostly picture of a man was captured on a webcam.

The team investigate claims of paranormal activity at a house in Hollywood, CA near the site of the 1969 Manson Murders. Then TAPS heads to the film studio built by Charlie Chaplain to check out claims of activity including full apparitions.
This week TAPS is in the Pacific Northwest to investigate former insane asylum,the Northern State Hospital.

TAPS heads to San Francisco to investigate claims of activity at the Presidio. Then they talk to a family who believe that an old employee and family friend is still coming to work 20 years after her death.

Kelly hasn’t thought about love since Andrew ended their engagement. Now he’s back, and so is their chemistry, as she competes on a Valentine’s Day cooking show.

Partially deaf himself, high school senior Jonah volunteers at 'No Limits,' a nonprofit teaching deaf children skills to succeed. Now, Lacey and her team are ready to throw this teen role model a true Hollywood red carpet gala.

Cypher and Bibleman are going to jail!? Oh, they’re visiting some young men at a juvenile detention centre. And the little brother of one of the inmates wants to meet Bibleman, so Pastor Lewis is taking Logan there on Bible study day.

David is not happy having a new babysitter. David and Carter decide to behave badly. The new babysitter exhibits the Fruit of patience and kindness and they all enjoy a huge banana split together as a peace offering.

Holy Moly turns the Bible into a living, breathing colouring book that will delight children of all ages. Eyes will be fixed on the screen, observing how God is at work in the story when colour is introduced to an otherwise black-and-white world. Rather than dialogue, the series focuses on the Biblical characters’ actions and emotions to help audiences of any language or background immediately relate to and remember these enriching stories.

Join Kyle, Lyds, Extra Bear, and Stu as they share with you some cool vids, catchy catch phrases crazy challenges, things you can do in 3 minutes, and other random stuff to make your life awesome. It’s the Blello Show! Let’s go!
Join Pastor Steven in the Basin where he digs deep into scripture and breaks down the Word of God in these short conversational teachings.

In this episode, two of Air Ivanhoe’s bush pilots take a two-day trip into a remote wilderness cabin — the first people to set foot there in more than a year. What they find is pure northern reality: trees fallen across boats, trails blocked all the way to the outhouse, and a camp that needs serious attention before fishing can begin. With tools in hand, the pilots and a third friend cut, lift, clear, and repair until the outpost is usable again. A stubborn weed-wacker that refuses to start slows them down, but bush ingenuity keeps the mission alive. Once the work is done, they finally hit the water, rewarded with steady walleye and pike action all day long. When they realize they’ve forgotten oil and butter for cooking, the solution is pure northern genius — bacon, sizzling in the pan with fresh fillets. As night falls, the crew secures the floatplane to shore with long ropes and settles in for a true backcountry evening. A mix of labour, laughs, mechanical headaches, big fish, and wi
You've seen her in the kitchen before, but this time it's Jeni's turn to show off her culinary skills. Jeni, joined by her close friends and family, is cooking up some of her favourite autumn foods.

As the final patients disembark, Gabrielle and Beth plan a meaningful celebration. Amid the goodbyes and gratitude, Breanna and Anton share exciting personal news, adding a joyful note to a day filled with reflection, closure, and hope for what’s next.

p.t: Written in Chalk: The Echo of Arthur Stace
p.d: For 35 years the word 'Eternity' was seen written in chalk on Sydney’s streets. Discover the legend of Arthur Stace, the man who became 'Mr Eternity' and how that word ended up in lights, glowing brilliantly across the Harbour Bridge.
A story about the power of education, Mission: Educate uncovers the transformation that can occur in nations, one life at a time, by combating poverty And changing lives through education.

Examines the significance and grandeur of the ancient city of Jerusalem and its relationship to biblical history. Shot on location, this film explores the unique location, history and archaeology of this crucial city in human history.

Gary Kent is the speaker for The Incredible Journey. He is an archaeologist who has excavated numerous sites throughout Israel and Jordan. He holds a BA in Theology, MA in Ancient History And Archaeology, and M in Divinity. As an internationally-acclaimed speaker and TV presenter, he has spoken and produced numerous documentaries on subjects including the Bible, Bible prophecy, world events, historical places and natural health. His passion is to share the good news of Jesus’ soon return.

Pastor Joseph Prince preaches dynamic messages centred on the pure gospel of the grace of God. His desire is to help believers understand grace and how greatly blessed, highly favoured and deeply loved they are by their heavenly Father.
Host Amanda Herrera shows us why fresh is always best with two creative dishes using ingredients from the farmers' market.
Zestful cook Amanda Herrera scoops up raspberries, peas, mint, and apricots to use in three summer recipes.
Host Amanda Herrera prepares a frittata, rosemary skewer chicken and grilled bread salad with fresh ingredients from a local farmers' market.
Warm host Amanda Herrera picks up colorful produce and herbs at a farmers' market to make a delicious appetizer and tasty cold oil French fries.

Chef-host Shahir Massoud tries out recipes from Al Roker and his daughter Courtney Roker Laga’s cookbook Al Roker’s Recipes to Live By! Follow along as Shahir prepares chicken shawarma bowls, Maryland-style crab cakes, and a spectacular chili!
The Italian region Campania is known for its seafood and pizza. Famed Chef Michael Bonacini prepares classics like Margherita Pizza and Fried Seafood.

Chef-host Shahir Massoud tries out recipes from another award-winning cookbook: Anna Olson’s Baking Wisdom! Follow along as Shahir makes a breakfast galette, a classic apple tart, a rich brown butter pecan pie, and much more!

With only 30 minutes and the clock ticking, can Vanessa make a meal using leftovers for 4 for about 40 bucks? On the menu: panzanella salad, stuffed peppers, cheese fondue, and chocolate banana crostini!
With only 30 minutes and the clock ticking, can Vanessa make an East Coast-inspired meal for 4 for about 40 bucks? On the menu: clam chowder, shrimp rolls, a simple salad, and blueberry cobbler!

With only 30 minutes and the clock ticking, can Vanessa make a pool party meal for 4 for about 40 bucks? On the menu: grilled steak with chimichurri, spinach salad with pickled radish, and fruit salad with coconut and basil!

Patagonia, in southern Argentina, is a unique and rugged land with mountains and lakes and wilderness. Chef Natalia Machado knows that land well, and she's making recipes that come from Patagonia. First up is Patagonia-style empanadas, which have a lamb filling. Lamb is big business in Patagonia, and this filling makes the most of that flavour with honey and smoked paprika. After Natalia fills her empanada dough, she teaches us the secrets to finishing off the edges in traditional styles, before deep-frying these pockets of deliciousness. Next up is Patagonia King Crab Pie. Chunks of egg bread mix with milk and white wine and other ingredients before succulent crab meat is added. Natalia puts the mixture in ramekins before topping with parmesan cheese that will create a golden crust on these little pies. Trucha a la sal is next: fish covered in a thick salt coating. Natalia makes herb-flavoured butter, and puts coins of it into the belly of the fish. Then, she teaches us the trick to m.
Unlock Gusto TV's top recipes on QR Countdown! Thousands of viewers scan our QR codes to access our delicious dishes. Now, we're serving up 8 of our most popular recipes featuring bananas!

Chef Kyle Crawford pulls back the curtain on sour sauces! First a brown butter picatta sauce for chicken picatta! Next, a smoked tomato ponzu sauce for fried oysters and a duo of orange marmalade and lemon curd for crepes!

Tacos take a turn on the griddle, blending time-honored tradition with new inspiration. Crisped tortillas, inventive fillings, and vibrant toppings come together in a celebration of the world’s most versatile handheld meal.
Vanessa Gianfrancesco creates an international menu with brunch recipes from around the world.

Paranormal investigators Corine, Leanne and Kelly tap into the bloody history of one of Ireland's ghostliest spots, and they find out who, or what, is lurking in the shadows of this terrifying fortress, which could be a portal to the underworld.
Following paranormal investigators Leanne Sallenback, Kelly Ireland and Corine Carey as they begin their travels up British Columbia's famed gold rush trail to explore its history and its hauntings.
Following paranormal investigators Leanne Sallenback, Kelly Ireland and Corine Carey as they begin their travels up British Columbia's famed gold rush trail to explore its history and its hauntings.

When investigators hunt the spirit of a man who took his own life, one investigator is overcome by something even darker. In Iowa, a father-daughter team comes face-to-face with the ghost of an axe-murderer. In Massachusetts, the spirit of an old sea captain grapples with lead investigator, Jack Kenna.

Learn about the ghost of a crazed murderer who will stop at nothing to keep the secrets of his crimes buried, a man suffering from violent and unrelenting hauntings, and an investigator who makes a very dangerous mistake.
All hell breaks loose when paranormal investigators disturb tortured spirits trapped in an old passenger train with a tragic past.

In Ontario, a former funeral home's dark past comes back to haunt investigator Michelle Desrochers. Father-daughter team Alan and Anna Tolf investigate a crumbling mansion only to be terrorised by the angry spirit of a scorned wife. In Ohio, ghost hunters are called to a family home, where the spirit of a former owner has returned to threaten the new inhabitants.

Susan has been wrestling with the untimely death of her brother and nephew for years and the phenomena Susan experienced prior to his passing almost seems to be a macabre foreshadowing to the torment she still feels because of his death.

A practitioner of Spiritism, named Angelique, discovers a deep bond with her aunt could extend from beyond the grave and is possibly connecting her with the terrifying premonitions of death she receives of those closest to her.

Test a young woman’s paranormal prowess. Learn how she discovered her mediumship abilities during childhood and look at the series of supernatural encounters with loved ones that have sharpened her senses over the years.

Leitreanna, a lifelong practitioner of Seminole spiritualism, believes that she was visited by her departed father as she endured an excruciating operation, seeing him comfort her when she was in blinding pain.
After mending her relationship with her mum following a cancer diagnosis, Stacy believes a series of paranormal occurrences are a testament to the love they share, even beyond the grave.

Jessica recounts how as a child, she was visited nightly by President Abraham Lincoln and a woman in a herringbone dress, and Jessica was shocked to learn the true identities of these figures after her mother opened a family album.

Kaitlin, who ardently wished to see her mother after her passing, finally has that wish fulfilled, however she soon learned that this experience was only one leg of her family's strange paranormal journey, dating back to her childhood.
Return to the Grand Victorian to hunt for ghostly Union soldiers who move furniture. Some paranormal claims are debunked, while tunnels below may have been part of the Underground Railroad.
The contestants must prepare a thirty-minute meal in which a slot machine randomly determines the ingredients that they can use. The winners go on a shopping spree for kitchenware and utensils.
US cooking competition with Gordon Ramsay. It's steak night and the contestants must prepare some beef for Chef Ramsey and during a special steakhouse service.

The chefs play craps as a team and during dinner service flawless VIP service is the goal. Including special celebrity guests, Carrot Top, Lee DeWyze, and David Beckham. Can the chefs keep these VIPs happy before another chef ends up in the crapper?
US cooking competition with Gordon Ramsay. Following a food eating competition and a blind taste test the teams must create their own menu for service consisting of nine courses.
US cooking competition with Gordon Ramsay. The contestants choose their own menu to be graded by diners, but both teams let the pressure get to them.

Well kiss my grits the chefs are doin' some down home cookin', y'all! Chef Ramsay welcomes a gospel choir and the chefs update some classic southern dishes! After a good ol' south of Mason Dixie dinner service, once chef is left deep fried.

US cooking competition with Gordon Ramsay. The teams have to prepare three dishes of Chef Ramsay's choosing, taking it in turns to complete the dish. One team feels the heat during service and needs help from their rivals to get the food out.

It's time of the 'Taste It Now Make It' challenge. Plus, the chefs get a blast from the past. Will the chefs in their snazzy new black jackets be able to overcome their present obstacle and which chef will no longer have a future in Hell's Kitchen?

Gordon tasks the final five contestants with teaching others how to cook by recreating one of his favorite dishes using only their verbal communication skills; the chef's students struggle to match professional-grade cuisine on their own.
World renowned chef Gordon Ramsay puts the remaining young chefs through rigorous and devastating challenges at his restaurant in Hollywood.

In an intense battle between the two remaining chefs as they tackle the final dinner service and a few other tests. It's the concluding competition for the position of head chef at Gordon Ramsay Steak in Las Vegas.
US cooking competition with Gordon Ramsay. The competition concludes as the two finalists battle it out for the position of head chef at Gordon Ramsay Steak at the Paris Las Vegas.

Twenty aspiring chefs divide into teams of men and women and try to impress Chef Gordon Ramsay with their signature dish; the winning team gets to sit down to dinner with Ramsay while the losers are left to clean up the kitchen.

Chef Ramsay sets up a tricycle relay race that requires both teams to work in pairs to accomplish basic culinary tasks, and the winning team gets to go to San Francisco while the losing team is relegated to picking carrots at a farm.

The chefs learn about teamwork via a challenge starting with pigs and potatoes and ending in the kitchen, and the winners earn a day aboard a yacht while the losers must bathe livestock; Ramsay kicks a team out of the kitchen during dinner service.
Tarek and Christina are lured to North Hollywood, CA, by a 1930s Spanish home.
Two professors fell in love with Vietnam while on a Semester at Sea program, so much so that they're leaving Florida to move to Ho Chi Minh City.
A young couple hunts for their first place in Chicago but can't decide between a condo in the city and a single-family home in the suburbs.
A couple living inland in Southern California enlist Heather Rae El Moussa to help find a house by the beach.
Three years after facing tragedy, a couple want to find their dream home in Burleson, Texas. They hope to open the area's first female-run brewery.
Christina returns to work after having her baby, but she may need help from her friends as she juggles a newborn and tackles her new clients' home.

p.t: My Lottery Dream Home: Where Are They Now?
p.d: David Bromstad checks in with past winners to see how they've grown into their dream homes in Ohio, Florida, and the Gulf Shores.
Two friends want to make the move to flipping, but they dove straight into a previously abandoned flip that has red flags left and right.
Dave and Jenny help two empty nesters upgrade their house. They transform the home with a rustic Cape Cod inspired look and add personal touches.
Despite working long hours, a young couple couldn't afford to buy a home in pricey San Francisco. They're hoping for a bargain in Edinburgh, Scotland.
Tarek and Christina take a risk on a huge home in Anaheim Hills, CA, in hopes of making more money after sharing the profits.
Christina helps her good friend and business partner, Cara, and Cara's husband remodel their main bedroom and bath.
Having ended their romantic relationship but remaining business partners,two Flipping 101 graduates are chasing their biggest profit yet.

The legendary Vietnam-era helicopter takes to the air in a pristine war-veteran example. We hear the story of an aircraft blown up by its own missiles, followed by the saga of a wounded copilot who went on to found a world-leading charity.

Developed just a bit too late for WWII, it was called an aerial anachronism: a piston engine warplane in a world of jets and missiles. However, it would fulfill its purpose during the Korean and Vietnam wars.
1968 was a year marked by assassinations, a contentious presidential election, an escalating anti-Vietnam War sentiment, and more.
They fought their way through Europe, survived overwhelming odds, liberated concentration camps, and drank a victory toast at Hitler's hideout.
Revisit the rise and fall of the Inca Empire with new discoveries that challenge old myths of ruthless giants.

December 1914. After 5 months of war, both the Germans and the Allies have dug themselves in behind impenetrable lines. Faced with this siege, the soldiers will bring back into use an old weapon that they will modernize: mines, blowing up enemy fortifications from beneath...
Examine Qin Shi Huangdi, the man who united, and indeed gave China its name. His legacy includes the Great Wall and his astonishing tomb, guarded by the Terracotta Army.
Explore Clinton's transformative, controversial presidency. Learn about his upbringing and public career.
In the 17th century, as the smoke cleared from the civil war, the first celebrity criminals emerged. Mounted soldiers from the losing royalist armies turned to a life of crime, becoming 'Highwaymen'.
Charting the devastating impact pirates had during an age of colonial expansion.
Sam Willis explores urban crime, fraud and corruption in the eighteenth century and uncovers a fascinating rogues gallery of charmers, fraudsters and villains.
Athens, a small hamlet in its early days, was established on abandoned land in 3,000 BC, but it would be transformed into one of the greatest ancient cities in the 5th century B.C.
4th century B.C.: Alexander the Great sets out to transform a fishing village into the ancient world's most dazzling city; feast your eyes on a reconstruction of the city and its amazing buildings.

p.t: Landslide: The Presidency of Herbert Hoover
p.d: President Herbert Hoover presided over the Great Depression before losing his reelection bid to FDR in 1932.
The Nazi regime spread terror across Europe, as Hitler's promises of greatness and racial purity secured public support while enabling horrific eugenics programs and inhumane medical experiments.

Confront the indoor air pollutants that have been making Jayson, Tammy, and their infant son, Jacob, sick. Stand by as Mike calls in a team of experts to banish not only dangerous black mould but also asbestos so the family can breathe easier.

Assess the damage done by a large bathroom-reno company, which turned a simple loo overhaul into a nasty experience. Join Mike and his crew, who ditch the bad energy and deliver the beautiful washroom the homeowner ordered.

Blow the lid off the myth that new is better as Steven and Jennifer deal with surprising drawbacks in their freshly built home. Mike shines a light on glaring deficiencies and offers solutions that make this new house feel like home.

Review Kim and Jason’s home-inspection report, which failed to disclose some serious safety issues in their dream house. Head to their three-acre property with Mike and the crew, who are on a mission to turn this family nightmare around.

Catch up on Clay and Clayton's laundry list of repairs made after a seemingly thorough home inspection, and discover issues this duo is too tapped out to tackle. Watch Mike, Damon and the crew create a fix-it plan everyone can live with.

Encounter a disturbing problem hidden beneath a beautiful exterior. Look around Gail and Kevin’s family home, which was renovated just prior to purchase. Then learn what Mike and the crew will have to do to make it spectacular.

Marvel at the open concept airiness of Josette and Jeff's new home, which came with sloped floors and sticking doors on the second storey. Watch as Mike outlines major flaws in the home-inspection report that might require expert support.

Head back into Josette and Jeff’s open concept house, where sloped floors point to a crucial structural issue. Follow Mike, Damon, and a pack of pros as they work around the clock to give this home, and the owners, a much-needed lift.

Look behind the scenes of one of Mike’s most personal contracting jobs: helping his son, MJ, turn his bachelor pad bungalow into a family home. See why Mike’s ambitious plan to gut the house and add a second storey isn’t exactly what MJ had in mind.

Feel the tension ratchet up as Mike and MJ go three rounds over every decision, from second floor layout to exterior brick choice to the addition of a dishwasher. Learn why it was all worth it when the entire Holmes crew arrives for the big reveal.

Feel Jim and Lisa’s heartbreak over the friendly contractor who abandoned their basement reno without fessing up that he’d underpriced the job. See how Mike and a team of specialists finally serve up the English pub this couple was thirsting for.

Learn how a corrupt contractor left Ron and Jill with no money, nowhere to live, and no legal leg to stand on. Watch the Holmes crew work day and night to complete the structure, plumbing, and finish work on their second-floor addition.
Tread carefully in Ann’s home, where the hardwood-over-concrete floor has a chronic moisture problem. Learn why three different contractors’ quick fixes didn’t work.

An investigative team tackles one of the biggest questions of our time: Are we alone? Meanwhile, Emily travels to the SETI institute to meet with leading scientists Jill Tarter and Seth Shostak to learn how we are searching for intelligent life in our universe.

Emily is joined by experts who are learning everything they can about asteroids and their potential impact on earth. From the dinosaur killer to the Chelyabinsk meteor of 2013 - we learn about the destructive power of asteroids.

Following in the footsteps of the Klondike gold rush, George heads north to the Yukon Territory and Alaska, but it's not gold he's seeking. It's the intense summer wildfires that often plague the area during their 24 hours of daylight. He travels by train, bike, plane and whitewater raft to reach the fires but Mother Nature has other plans for him and doesn't make things easy.

Hurricanes are the largest storms on Earth and George has been through many of them. This year he starts off by getting prepared in a wind tunnel, then he and his chase partner Mark Robinson head to Newfoundland for more wild weather action. Then, it's off to another encounter where the wild wind fans a raging inferno.

2005 seemed to be the year that Earth went wild. Follow George as he brings us back to the site of his hairiest adventures from that year. Whether it's descending into a volcano in the most remote corner of Ethiopia, almost driving into a tornado in Texas or facing down hurricane Katrina, George was right there at ground zero and lived to tell the tale.

Kasanka National Park in Zambia is home to an unusual species of baboon. Kinda baboons have turned their backs on the aggressive displays of dominance usually associated with these large monkeys and lead altogether more peaceful lives. Living alongside one troop is a dedicated team of researchers whose mission it is to uncover these baboons' secrets and understand what makes them who they are.

Get to know Fera, the Queen of the Pantanal, as she teaches her rambunctious cub Simba how to climb trees and hunt for dinner. Then learn why Ferinha, another local female, struggles with motherhood as more males move in and threaten the youngsters.

Explore the shores of the Northern Territory and the abundant waters of the Great Barrier Reef. Face flooded roads, hungry saltwater crocs, and killer jellyfish as Lizzie investigates why so many strange, deadly creatures make this remote area home.

Say goodbye to the tropics and dip into cool southern-coast waters. Come face to face with majestic grey nurse sharks, shape-shifting cuttlefish, and huge blue whales; play with penguins and sea lions; and learn why these seas are brimming with life.

Chilema is an Elephant with half a trunk; losing the tip to a poacher's snare. It was intended to catch antelope for bushmeat. But the snare's indiscriminate nature means other animals often fall foul of them, with devastating results. Chilema is now having to adapt to life without an elephants most important appendage. She must learn how to eat, drink and also take a mud bath to ensure her survival. With the added challenge of the harsh dry season, Chilema is fighting against the odds to survive.

Bonaire's fringing reef is home to thousands of species of corals, fish and other marine animals. It is also home to a collection of stunning shipwrecks. These wrecks evolve over time, becoming artificial reefs that support an incredibly diverse marine habitat.

The Lilayi Elephant Nursery near Lusaka in Zambia is home to four orphan elephants. The two oldest, four-year- olds Musolole and Zambezi, have been here since they were just a few months old. These boisterous babies are out-growing the nursery and it's time to move to big school. Two hundred miles away, in the heart of Kafue National Park, lies elephant heaven - Camp Phoenix, the project's release facility, where older orphans are already adapting to life in the wild.

The workers at the St. Louis Zoo address the nutritional needs of animal family groups, including a herd of elephants with multiple generations, meerkat siblings, and a young tree kangaroo who needs to eat his first solid meal.

The employees at the St. Louis Zoo attempt to properly manage the nutritional needs of zoo residents who are picky eaters or who have complex dietary needs, including a giant anteater, a group of giraffes and a group of lemurs.

Staff at the zoo know it’s important to feed the minds of the animals too. From puzzles and piñatas to honey tubes and herb gardens, explore the activities zookeepers introduce to help keep boredom at bay.
How do you feed the animals that swim, dip, and dive? See how the zookeepers dole out buckets of fish for the sea lions and penguins, and present bouquets of veggies to the century-old tortoises.

Feeding critically endangered species is an incredibly critical task. When you’re feeding animals teetering on the edge of extinction, every bite counts. See how zoo staff nourishes orangutans, cheetahs, and painted dogs.
Zookeepers can’t let their guards down when it comes to feeding dangerous species. Learn the strategies zoo staff employ to feed ferocious hunters such as tigers, sun bears, and rhinos.

The Burella family is looking for a puppy for their two young daughters. They visit a Havanese, Chinese Crested. and the Coton de Tulear. Both girls have a favourite, but mom surprises her daughters with her vote.
Gear up for adventure as a family considers Pomeranians and other playful dogs.

Get cozy with three special rescue dogs vying to be the Chambers family’s new addition. Tag along as Beverley hooks them up with Abby, Liam, and Takaro, three sweet Lab mixes who have all the energy and love required to win them over.

Check on a rescue puppy who has a laundry list of problems. Can Dr. Scott help give her a normal life? Then follow Wellum, a terrier that arrives with a special malady. Later, the pressure is on when head nurse Emma brings in her own cat.

Face unexpected drama when an elderly comes in for surgery to remove a lump in his abdomen. Then get to know Coco, the overweight pooch that needs a knee operation. Later, Dr. Scott helps his personal trainer’s shar-pei get a facelift.

Join the hunt for a moose on the loose who’s raising a ruckus in the neighbourhood. Back at the farm, a permanent resident has become a loveable nuisance. Special guests arrive at the rehab center bearing a treat for Hope’s dedicated volunteers.

The Fraser family looks for a dog to join their family. They meet with the Beagle, the Havanese, and with the Old English Sheep Dog. But can they convince Dad that there are other dogs besides the Old English Sheep Dog?

Pick up the pace as the Vargas family searches for an energetic breed that can keep up with their kids. Pay a visit to German shepherds, basset hounds, and goldendoodles in the quest to find a loving companion that’s up for all sorts of adventures.

Make a splash as the Frohlicks review Beverley’s picks for a dog that loves the water as much as they do. See if this family falls for a big-hearted Nova Scotia duck tolling retriever, a sassy mini dachshund, or a laid-back golden retriever.

Double trouble as Adam and Jamie tackle two classic comedy myths. Meanwhile, Kari, Grant and Tory cook up the biggest bang in MythBusters history testing if you can make homemade diamonds.

In over 14 years the MythBusters have detonated somewhere in the region of 1,000 explosions. In this episode-with-a-twist the team is reversing their SOP and doing something they’ve never done before - an implosion caused by a vacuum.
On this episode of Mythbusters the team hit the 007 button with a rocket powered ejector seat, and burst the bubble of an internet video sensation!

Are outlandish feats of human ability really possible, or is there sleight of hand at play? The MythBusters search for the truth behind the one-inch punch, needles thrown through glass and extinguishing a flame with the human voice.
We've all seen the Hollywood movies when a bad guy shoots a hole in a passenger jet and everyone gets sucked out the hole into the sky. Would it really happen?
The Magnificent Seven remain in the hunt and the competition cranks up with an age-old adage, Needle in a Haystack, and a classic Hollywood Handcuff cliche.
Duck and cover because the MythBusters are tackling two ballistic mysteries; is a dead body bullet proof and a non-Newtonian fluid bomb proof?!

It was one of the most popular episodes of all time. When the Mythbusters put humble duct tape through its paces in ‘101 Uses For Duct Tape’, fans went into a frenzy, demanding that more duct tape tall tales be put to the test. Well, let it never be said that the Mythbusters don’t listen to the fans, because here it is – ‘102 Uses For Duct Tape’.

In Mentos And Soda Adam and Jamie are trying to figure out the theory behind the chaos when diet cola and mentos mix. Inspired by an internet phenomenon The Mythbusters take on the controversy surrounding these fizzy fountains.

Put simply, this episode puts all our MythBusters ‘U.E.P.’- under extreme pressure. Adam and Jamie have unfinished business from their ‘Shark Week’ special, where they shot and then exploded a SCUBA tank.
The MythBusters investigate if it's possible to unblock a toilet with molten salt. The results are explosive, but has this salt really got game to fix your throne?

In this special episode, the MythBusters reveal what’s in store for their go big then go home final season, while also pulling back the curtain to showcase how this epic series got made with a behind-the-scenes exclusive.

Things are about to get unstable, volatile and dangerous... because it's the MythBusters Breaking Bad Special. Joined by creator Vince Gilligan, and start Aaron Paul, the MythBsuters are scrutinizing the science and checking the chemistry of the hit TV show 'Breaking Bad'.

Take two tow trucks, two semi trailers, a small European car and five Mythbusters and what do you get? Well with any luck, a precision collision that beats any crash yet seen on the show. After the head on from hell, you'll be needing a stiff one, so settle back and sample some myths about one of America's favourite alcoholic drinks.
Adam and Jamie take Mythbusting to the next level challenging the science of the virtual world rendered in video games - it’s game over for false physics!
From Cambodia's diverse wildlife to people living in the stilt villages of lake Tonle Sap, the Mekong has dictated the lives of everything that lives there for centuries.
The final country on the Mekong's journey is the home of the rivers mighty delta.Deposits of rich nutrients carried downstream from hundreds of kilometres makes this region, the jewel of Vietnam.
See predators and prey live side-by-side in a delicate balance.

The air is thin and cold, trees can’t even live here -­‐ it’s not exactly a welcoming place to live. But animals like mountain goats and bighorn sheep and even black bears manage to skitter around these peaks with ease. We’ll take a look at how these creatures manage to defy gravity, among some of the highest peaks on the continent.
Discover how lakes, rivers, and marshes are the key to thriving animal life.
At the northern edge of the Pantanal, in one of the largest tropical wetlands on Earth, is a small pond that is home to an unusual family of rodents.

Every year in the dry season, as the floodwaters disappear, the grasslands of the Pantanal are home to many species: giant anteaters, maned wolves and the greater rheas- the largest bird in South America.

An arid region in South Africa called Namaqualand is featured during its rainy season, which typically lasts two months, and a look is taken at the flurry of activity that takes place during this time, which includes the blooming of vivid flowers.
Investigate the power of kinship and see why family shapes every animal's story.
Over millennia, the Arctic's inhabitants have evolved to survive in a challenging but stable and predictable world. Now, they must rapidly adapt to a new and constantly changing environment.
Devon Island is the largest uninhabited island in the world. It's so remote and forbidding that when scientists wanted to simulate living conditions on Mars, they chose Devon.
The Western Arctic's mammoth Mackenzie Delta is the second largest in North America after the Mississippi. It is a biological transition zone - from the boreal forest to the ever frozen tundra.
Take a closer look at the rivalries that shape animal life in the Serengeti.
The episode explores what is at stake for animals that have no permanent home, relying entirely on the ground they stand on for survival.
Experience the power of water, which shapes every area of life in the Serengeti.

At 12, Crystal dated 20 year old Matt and was pregnant at 13. He served 15 months in prison for criminal sexual assault on a minor and is a registered sex offender. Are they a product of inappropriate love or just misunderstood?

Adrianna says her ex-fiancé is verbally and physically abusive, but he says he had every right to treat her that way to put her in her place.
Quentien fears that his girlfriend is cheating and his sister is covering up for her; Tabitha's boyfriend admitted to hooking up with a young woman, then took it back.

Stephanie’s drug addiction led her to neglect and abuse her kids. Scott’s fiancée stepped up as a mother and Stephanie failed multiple drug tests, he doesn’t want her near the kids, but wants her to atone for her wrongs!
Laharla caught her mother's boyfriend Victor cheating when she saw him through their window. Then, Aaron claims that a woman named Olivia will not leave him alone after they met in person.

Point Of View: When an alternate reality of Earth is invaded by the Goa'uld, their version of Dr Samantha Carter, along with Major Kawalsky, seeks refuge with Stargate Command.

SG-1 travels to planet PJ6-877 for a routine recon. Almost immediately after arriving, they are snared in an invisible forcefield by alien bounty hunter Aris Boch. Aris takes them to his cargo ship, which is completely invisible from the outside. He has come to this planet to hunt a Goa'uld named Kel'tar, who is wanted by the evil system lord Sokar.
SG-1 finds a medieval Christian society terrorized by Sokar and the Unas, and is accused of being possessed by demons.

Upon exiting the stargate, SG-1 finds itself in the midst of battle. A group of SG soldiers battles a Jaffa army. Believing the soldiers to be the missing-in-action SG-11 team, Col. Jack O'Neill and the others provide assistance. Much to their surprise, the mystery SG team turns their weapons against SG-1! SG-1 wakes up in the soldiers' training camp with headaches and no weapons.

During a rescue of captured Abydonians, Daniel finds his missing wife, Sha're. But instead of greeting him, she attacks him - leading to her death at the hands of Teal'c. Distraught over her death and angry at Teal'c, Daniel quits Stargate Command.
SG-1 encounters an entire planet suffering from amnesia. The planet's leader returns to Earth with SG-1 to find a cure.
Carter's father has been captured on a moon transformed into hell. Only Jolinar's memories can save him.

During a rescue attempt, SG-1 is caught by one of hell's denizens, who is determined to use the information they have to overthrow Goa'uld lord Sokar. Using Tok'ra technology, the team is forced to relive painful memories... but how much can they take?
Foothold: The team returns from a mission to find that no one at the Stargate Command is who they appear to be.

It's week four of the North Atlantic Blue Fin Tuna Season and oneveteran Gloucester captain has yet to catch his first fish, while two rival harpoon boats go head to head.

It’s week five of Gloucester’s bluefin tuna fishing season, and when a sudden storm engulfs the fleet, each captain must decide if the risk of staying out on the water is worth the reward of catching more bluefin tuna. For Captain TJ Ott of Hot Tuna, the storm is unwelcome as he pushes to maintain his lead over Captains Dave Carraro of FV-Tuna.com and Tyler McLaughlin of Pin Wheel.

It’s week six, and Pin Wheel has a narrow lead over last season’s champion fishing vessel Tuna.com, while Hot Tuna, Hard Merchandise and Kelly Ann are lagging behind. Now, Captain Paul Cheney and his crew are about to enter the scene and shake things up, with the smallest boat in the fleet — the fishing vessel Drama.
It's week seven of the North Atlantic Bluefin tuna fishing season, Gloucester captains must decide whether go where the fish are biting or take their chances fishing inshore.
It's week eight of the Atlantic bluefin tuna season, the midway point of fishing where crews either knuckle down and push hard, or crumble from the grind.
It's week nine of the North Atlantic bluefin tuna season and Captain Paul Hebert, struggles to prove his worth as a captain after catching only three tuna in the first two months of fishing.
It's week ten of the North Atlantic bluefin tuna season in Gloucester, Massachusetts, and, with only six weeks of fishing left, the competition is heating up.

It’s week 11 of the North Atlantic bluefin tuna season, and bad luck, bait problems and big egos plague the Gloucester fleet. With only five weeks of fishing left before the season closes, hardworking Captain Dave Marciano of Hard Merchandise has defied popular belief by rising to the top of the leaderboard for the first time this season.
It's week 12 of the North Atlantic Bluefin tuna season, and one captain's decision to withhold information fractures ties with an important ally.

It's week 13 of the North Atlantic Bluefin tuna season and, with only three weeks left to fish, and the number one position on the line, every Gloucester captain is desperate to stack the deck with bluefin.

It’s week 14 of the bluefin tuna season and with less than two weeks of fishing left, the top four crews are locked in a tight race to be Gloucester’s best bluefin boat. Though Captain Dave Marciano of Hard Merchandise has the slowest and most rundown boat, he and nephew Jay Muenzner are currently leading the fleet.

It’s the final week of the season and Hard Merchandise holds a narrow lead over the fleet with fifteen fish. Hard Merchandise’s closest rivals Dot Com, Pin Wheel, and Hot Tuna are all within striking distance of the lead and when a single tuna can cost upwards of $20,000 the battle for the top spot will go down to the final day.

There are less than five days left before the Atlantic Bluefin Tuna season in Gloucester, Massachusetts closes and the competition will come down to the very last day of fishing. The top four boats are only a fish or two away from each other in the race and it’s too close to call.
It’s the final week of the season and the competition is so close, it will come down to the very last day.

A new fishing season begins, and everyone is angling to bring in the first catch. Captain Dave Marciano of the Hard Merchandise is desperate to recover his finances after a bad season down south, while bitter rivals Captain Tyler McLaughlin of the Pinwheel and Captain Dave Carraro of the FV-Tuna.com are out to take each other down while vying for the title.
